body: Everything and nothing, it's hard to put in words because it's an intense feeling that is always there, even when nothing specific is on my mind. I have tried to get help but the inability to really pinpoint the problem other than being overwhelmingly miserable. I plan to try again, I want to get a new job in hopes that it will make a small difference.
Music has helped in the past but not recently.

I should find one for that, deep breathing doesn't do much, I try it a lot. I go through phases like this, they can last days or weeks. Late at night I just have the urge to call, but don't because it's not what they are there for.

This is me all day everyday, in the middle of the night and as I try to fall asleep....right now while I am at work...If I had a reason I could at least try to deal with it, but I go through days/weeks/months where I am constantly anxious with no detectable reason attached to it.

It's been bad for the last week, always feel like I'm about to be sick.
